items.verse: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَٰجِكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
items.verseEn: O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allāh has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

items.verse: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثًۭا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِۦ وَأَظْهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُۥ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِىَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
items.verseEn: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and Allāh showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Aware."

items.verse: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
items.verseEn: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.

items.verse: وَمَرْيَمَ ٱبْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَـٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِتِينَ
items.verseEn: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of ʿImrān, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.

categories.name: أَوَامِرُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي سُورَةِ الأَنْفَالِ
categories.nameEn: Commands to the Believers in Surah Al-Anfal

items.verse: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَا تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَأَنتُمْ تَسْمَعُونَ
items.verseEn: O you who have believed, obey Allāh and His Messenger and do not turn from him while you hear [his order].

items.verse: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّا تُصِيبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنكُمْ خَآصَّةًۭ ۖ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
items.verseEn: And fear a trial which will not strike those who have wronged among you exclusively, and know that Allāh is severe in penalty.

items.verse: وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ أَنتُمْ قَلِيلٌۭ مُّسْتَضْعَفُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ تَخَافُونَ أَن يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ فَـَٔاوَىٰكُمْ وَأَيَّدَكُم بِنَصْرِهِۦ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
items.verseEn: And remember when you were few and oppressed in the land, fearing that people might abduct you, but He sheltered you, supported you with His victory, and provided you with good things - that you might be grateful.

items.verse: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ زَحْفًۭا فَلَا تُوَلُّوهُمُ ٱلْأَدْبَارَ
items.verseEn: O you who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing [in battle], do not turn to them your backs [in flight].

categories.name: مَشَاهِدُ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي سُورَةِ الْمَعَارِجِ
categories.nameEn: Scenes of the Day of Judgment in Surah Al-Ma'arij

items.verseEn: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
And the mountains will be like wool,
And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,

items.verse: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
items.verseEn: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children.

categories.name: النَّاهِي عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي سُورَةِ الْعَلَقِ
categories.nameEn: The One Who Forbids the Servant from Praying in Surah Al-Alaq

items.verseEn: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
Then let him call his associates;
No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allāh].

harf.hint: The worldwide community of all Muslims
harf.arabicVerse: وَلْتَكُن مِّنكُمْ أُمَّةٌۭ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْخَيْرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
harf.verse: 3:104 - And let there be [arising] from you a nation inviting to [all that is] good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, and those will be the successful.

deduction.title: The Sovereign Who Traversed the Earth's Ends
deduction.intro: Imagine a powerful ruler, granted strength and authority over the land. This figure embarked on extraordinary journeys, reaching the place where the sun sets and the place where it rises, encountering strange peoples and facing a great challenge from two corrupting nations. Who is this enigmatic leader?
clues: I was a ruler granted authority and means to reach the farthest corners of the earth.
I journeyed to the west and witnessed the sun setting in a murky spring.
I encountered a people near the rising sun who had no shelter from its heat.
Another community asked my help against two corrupting nations known as Gog and Magog.
I built a barrier using iron and molten copper to contain them.
I declared that this barrier was a mercy from my Lord, and it will remain until the appointed time.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Building a barrier against Gog and Magog
trial.answer: Building a barrier against Gog and Magog

location.label: Key Element
options: A barrier of iron and copper
A staff that became a snake
location.answer: A barrier of iron and copper

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Gog and Magog were contained until the appointed time
outcome.answer: Gog and Magog were contained until the appointed time

deduction.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
deduction.verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)

scramble.hint: A powerful verse that combines tawhid (the oneness of Allah) with the command of tawakkul (placing full reliance upon Him).
scramble.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
scramble.verseEn: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.
